texto:
You can build a finance research agent this weekend.
Free tools. No PhD.

Here's the exact path I'd take. Every resource is free.

1. Learn the foundations
Claude Platform 101 (Anthropic Academy)
→ https://lnkd.in/eG95x-8J

2. Give it capabilities
Introduction to Agent Skills (Anthropic Academy)
→ https://lnkd.in/e7fb9MJU

3. Steal the architecture
TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
→ https://lnkd.in/e_27SdJF
(Read it for the role design: researcher, risk, trader. Not a strategy to run.)

4. Get the engineering right
Anthropic's Building effective agents guide
→ https://lnkd.in/epDfuwXP

The trap: people collect 40 resources and build nothing.

Do steps 1-4 in order, then build ONE narrow agent. "Summarize an earnings call + flag risks." Then ship it ugly.

A working ugly agent beats a perfect reading list every time.

💾 Save this as your weekend plan.
♻️ Repost for a builder who keeps "researching."
